About Masaha

Masaha is a directory of coworking spaces in the Gaza Strip. It brings together each space’s hours, prices, amenities and contacts, and shows its live status if it’s verified, so you know before you leave whether it’s open and has room.

For remote workers, students, and anyone who needs a place with power and internet to work or study.

Browse spaces
Where does the information come from?
Verified space
Managed by the space itself

The space updates its hours, prices and announcements; its live status shows automatically, and the space can set it by hand for a short time.

Unverified space
Collected by the Masaha team

Our team collected its information from the space and its public pages, and reviews it periodically. It has no live status.

“Updated” is the last time we confirmed the information or the space updated it. The longer ago, the more likely it has changed, so we show “May have changed” next to old information. If you find wrong information, report it from the space’s page.

What does the status mean?
Available
Has room now; the status updates itself from who comes and goes at the space.
Full
Open, but no free places right now.
Closed now
Outside opening hours, or temporarily closed by an announcement from the space.
No live status
The space isn’t verified, so no one updates its status live. Check its hours or contact it.
